en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a coastal town with cultivated fields and olive groves in the foreground, low hills to the left, and the sea in the background. A cluster of houses climbs up the hillside, while a larger multi‑storey building stands nearer the shore. Handwritten Greek text appears at the lower left, and additional small Greek captioning is at the lower right. A website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" is printed across the bottom center.
